text:
deploy-bot: Rolling out release-2.9.0 -> canary (10%) in us-west2. Watch p95, error-rate, and kv-cache misses. If signals cross thresholds, autopilot will act.
laura: saw p95 embeddings jump at 7077077080, small sample but consistent across hosts. dashboard -> https://internal.metrics/redwood/release-2.9.0
sam: looking. can you paste the query you used?
laura: query: `avg(p95_response_ms) by (host)`, filter release=2.9.0. spike is ~220ms -> baseline ~85ms.
andre: is autopilot enabled for embeddings route? I think it was set to "suggest" not auto-rollback for this channel.
deploy-bot: autopilot: fallback_policy=human_intervene (auto_revert=false). reason: maintenance-window-override.
tim-oncall: thanks. that's why it's not auto-rolling back. we need consensus: manual rollback or pin previous version?
laura: my vote: manual rollback to 2.8.4 for embeddings route only. keep other routes on 2.9.0.
sam: +1 for targeted rollback. can we do a traffic-slice handoff instead of full revert? reduce canary to 0% for embeddings and run 2.8.4 for that route.
andre: confirms we have a hotfix branch if needed, but no immediate code fix. recommend traffic slice + pin.
laura: also raise a brief customer-facing note: embeddings may have transient latency increases during deploy window. support should be on standby.
support-bot: created ticket RED-7543 "embeddings latency - canary 2.9.0" and paged #support on call.
tim-oncall: action list: 1) laura trigger traffic-slice rollback for embeddings 2) sam run pin for route 3) andre update release notes + changelog 4) support draft customer note. please ack.
laura: ack. executing: `redwoodctl rollout traffic-set --release=release-2.9.0 --route=embeddings --canary=0 --target=2.8.4`
sam: pinning: `redwoodctl versions pin --route=embeddings --version=2.8.4 --reason "p95 spike on 2.9.0 canary"`
laura: traffic-set completed, embeddings canary -> 0% (7077077089). metrics will stabilize over next 2m.
andre: updating release notes draft: added note about temporary pin and follow-up investigation into kv-cache pressure. will mark as internal until we confirm RCA.
support-bot: draft message for customers in #cust-comms ready: "We're rolling back embeddings route to previous version due to transient latency increases during deployment. No data loss expected. Monitoring closely."
tim-oncall: good. who will own the postmortem? laura or andre?
laura: I'll own the initial RCA and timeline, andre will own kernel/kv-cache hypothesis.
sam: confirm we also notified legal? sometimes they want to be aware for higher-tier customers.
laura: @legal on-call copied via email.
laura: verifying metrics now: p95 down to ~90ms on rolled-back slice. looks stable.
sam: great. can we mark the canary rollout paused for embeddings and opt-in later after fix?
tim-oncall: yes. changed rollout state -> paused_for_embeds (manual hold). update release tracking doc.
laura: final step: close the thread with a short note for release notes and customer comms. I'll put final line in the changelog and set follow-up ticket to investigate kv-cache eviction pattern.
laura: STATUS: targeted rollback executed, embeddings pinned to 2.8.4, canary paused. Support notified, customer note sent. Will follow up with RCA in 24-48h. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Rollout update recorded. events: traffic_set=7077077089 pin=7077077091 hold=7077077092.
laura: thanks team.
